data.content_ref: inline:Introduce a derived label ABSTAIN for committed roots that are currently suspended; ABSTAIN roots do not participate in attack evaluation but are recorded as pending. Compute the grounded labeling in two phases: first on the subgraph induced by non-ABSTAIN nodes, then re-evaluate ABSTAIN nodes against the resulting labels without changing any non-ABSTAIN label. This expands expressiveness without touching edge construction. Criticizable because the second phase is not a monotone operator on the full lattice, so determinism depends on phase ordering, and a committed root may become out in phase two while its committed status forbids it.
